description: This file contains a utility function 'normalizeRows' which processes CSV rows to conform to a canonical schema by mapping headers, parsing date fields, coercing numeric values, and normalizing percentages. It is used in a React frontend application to transform raw CSV data for further analysis or display.

methods.name: normalizeRows(rows = [])
methods.description: Converts raw CSV rows to a canonical schema, coercing numbers and dates, and normalizing date formats and percentage values.
